Saras is developing this pioneering technology in partnership with industry-leading Fortune 500 companies and other innovative computing solution providers to support best-in-class, energy-efficient products. Our vision is to change the performance-to-power paradigm for next generation computing solutions through heterogeneously integrated Saras Micro Devices products. We provide competitive salary and benefit plans, and some of the best co-workers you’ll find anywhere. Partner with executive and department leaders to evaluate and implement technology projects. Cybersecurity, Risk and Compliance Own the cybersecurity program, security roadmap, and day-to-day security operations, including endpoint protection, email security, MFA, conditional access, vulnerability management, backups, network security, data protection, and access controls. Develop and maintain IT policies, SOPs, controls, evidence, and remediation plans that support audits, customer requirements, and company compliance obligations. Coordinate security awareness, phishing prevention, incident response, risk reviews, and third-party security activities. Apply least privilege, separation of duties, change control, and documented approval practices across systems. Plan and execute infrastructure upgrades, office and manufacturing buildouts, site expansions, refresh projects, and business continuity improvements. Monitor capacity, reliability, backups, warranties, and support coverage; coordinate troubleshooting and escalation with vendors when needed. Lead cross-functional implementation and improvement efforts. Maintain appropriate system administration, change control, documentation, and support ownership for other critical business applications. Assets, Endpoints and Employee Technology Own hardware and software lifecycle management, asset inventory accuracy, standards, purchasing, deployment, maintenance, recovery, and disposal. Maintain a multi-year device refresh plan and use inventory, warranty, endpoint-management, and budget data to guide replacement decisions. Ensure new hires, transfers, and departing employees receive timely and secure technology support, including mobile access, authentication, building access coordination, and application provisioning. Vendors, Contracts and Budget Develop and manage the IT operating and capital budgets, forecasts, renewals, purchase requests, licensing, and cost optimization activities. Serve as the primary relationship manager for managed service providers, consultants, carriers, software vendors, and hardware partners; hold partners accountable for delivery, security, cost, and documentation. Automation, Data and AI Enablement Identify and implement automation and self-service opportunities using Microsoft Power Platform, scripting, APIs, and other approved tools. Enable responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and other approved AI services by establishing access, licensing, governance, security boundaries, user guidance, and practical use cases. Strong administration and governance experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Microsoft security tools. Demonstrated experience with cybersecurity operations, identity and access management, endpoint security, backups, incident response, risk management, and policy development. Solid working knowledge of enterprise networking, wireless, firewalls, switching, internet connectivity, Windows endpoints, servers, and cloud services. Experience leading ERP, MES, ECM, or other cross-functional business-system implementations and support, preferably in a manufacturing environment. Experience with IT asset management, lifecycle planning, procurement, licensing, vendor management, contracts, and budgeting. Working knowledge of PowerShell, SQL, reporting, APIs, workflow automation, or the ability to direct and validate this work. Strong business judgment with the ability to explain technical risk, cost, and tradeoffs in clear language to nontechnical stakeholders. Clear communication, documentation, prioritization, and problem-solving skills with a practical, company-wide mindset. Ability to work independently, identify gaps, seek outside expertise when appropriate, and remain effective in a fast-changing environment. Core Competencies Technical Expertise: Demonstrates strong knowledge of systems administration, infrastructure, networking, and Microsoft technologies. Problem Solving: Effectively diagnoses issues, identifies root causes, and implements practical solutions. Security Mindset: Consistently applies security best practices and protects company systems, data, and access. Customer Service: Provides professional, responsive, and user-focused technical support. Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for systems, projects, issues, and follow-through. Communication: Clearly communicates technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences. Organization: Maintains accurate documentation, asset records, configurations, and support information. Collaboration: Works effectively with employees, managers, vendors, and cross-functional teams. Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, efficiency, and the employee technology experience. Experience with the following is preferred: Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot administration, AI governance, and workflow automation. Epicor Kinetic, Epicor MES, DocStar/ECM, BAQs, dashboards, or comparable ERP and manufacturing platforms. Multi-site manufacturing, semiconductor, engineering, or regulated technology environments. Experience supporting site buildouts, access control, cameras, low-voltage projects, and business continuity planning. Relevant Microsoft, security, networking, IT service management, or project-management certifications. Technical Skills Required: Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Entra ID Teams SharePoint Online Intune Endpoint Management Microsoft Defender Network Administration VPN IT Asset Management Preferred: Epicor Kinetic ERP, Epicor MES, DocStar/ECM, SQL, reporting and integration tools Ubiquiti Ubiquiti Protect Brivo Access Control Microsoft Azure PowerShell Education and Certifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience may be considered. Ability to occasionally lift, carry, and install IT equipment. Ability to work in office, server/IT, and operational environments as required. You also administer and support the end-user, identity, and collaboration platforms Rithum runs on, so the automation you build is grounded in hands-on ownership of those systems. You partner closely with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify where automation can reduce risk and free up capacity, and you are accountable for the reliability of the automation you build. All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, confidentiality, and compliance. Responsibilities Automation Development & Engineering Design, build, and maintain automation scripts and workflows (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash) that streamline IT service delivery, endpoint provisioning, and systems administration tasks. Design, build, and own automated workflows across user lifecycle, device provisioning, and identity lifecycle using Rithum's existing platforms (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf) and API and webhook integrations. Instrument automations with logging and alerting so every action is auditable and measurable, tracking hours saved and errors reduced rather than only whether a workflow ran. Translate manual, repetitive IT operations processes into reliable, documented, automated solutions, adapting existing scripts and tools to address new and evolving business needs. Use AI tools to accelerate script development, troubleshoot automation failures, and draft technical documentation, verifying outputs before they are applied to production systems. Enterprise Systems Administration & Support Administer, configure, and monitor end-user and identity platforms such as Active Directory, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Jamf, and Tanium, escalating architectural decisions on complex integrations to senior IT Operations teammates. Administer and support collaboration and productivity platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams. Resolve end-user computing issues across Windows and macOS through the ticketing queue, direct messaging, and voice or video sessions, owning requests end-to-end and escalating critical incidents and system alerts to senior IT Operations. Document technical solutions so they are accurate, secure, and aligned with corporate IT and Information Security standards and policies. Partner with the Service Desk, Infrastructure Engineering, and Information Security teams to identify recurring manual tasks that are strong candidates for automation. Collaborate with partner teams to test, deploy, and monitor automation workflows, tailoring communication to technical and non-technical audiences. Provide occasional guidance to Service Desk teammates on scripting fundamentals and automation best practices as your experience grows. Process Documentation & Continuous Improvement Document automation workflows, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides so that solutions remain supportable and repeatable across the IT organization. Own the automation knowledge base, keeping runbooks and integration notes current so what you build is repeatable and supportable by others rather than dependent on you. Apply lessons learned from prior automation efforts to improve reliability, reduce inefficiencies, and anticipate dependencies in future builds. Monitor the performance and reliability of deployed automations, escalating and resolving issues within your area of ownership. AI-Enabled Productivity & Innovation Use AI as your starting point for recurring IT work — configuration research, scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution design — so your output is clearer and needs less rework. Validate AI-generated scripts, configurations, and recommendations in non-production environments before applying them, following Rithum's responsible AI use and data security standards. Share effective AI-assisted approaches and prompts with teammates when they meaningfully improve automation quality or speed. Continuously identify opportunities where automation and AI can be applied to Business Technology workflows, escalating larger opportunities to your manager. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 2+ years of experience in IT systems administration, service desk operations, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience writing and maintaining automation scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar). Hands-on experience administering or supporting enterprise identity, collaboration, and productivity platforms such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams. Demonstrated experience adapting or troubleshooting existing automation, scripts, or workflows to resolve moderately complex, ambiguous technical issues. Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through research, communication, analysis, documentation, automation, workflow optimization, and decision-making. Demonstrated hands-on use of AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to build, ship, or automate a working solution, evidenced by a portfolio, repository, or project example. Located in the United States Central or Mountain time zone, with working hours aligned to that time zone. Handle escalations requiring cross-team coordination. Participate in an on-call rotation for urgent issues outside business hours. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences. Must be available for occasional travel to Rithum offices - anticipated quarterly. Successful professional experience working in a remote environment. Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of experience in IT automation, systems engineering, or a DevOps-adjacent role. Certifications such as CompTIA Server+, CompTIA Linux+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent scripting/automation certifications. Experience integrating automation with IT service management or endpoint management tooling (e.g., ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Jira). Experience with workflow orchestration or automation tooling (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato). Familiarity with REST API integration patterns and event-driven concepts such as webhooks, triggers, and conditional logic. Exposure to endpoint management and protection platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Tanium, CrowdStrike). Personal projects, repositories, or hackathon work demonstrating scripting or automation ability. What It’s Like To Work At Rithum When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds. As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans. review_candidates.description: About The Company SISL Global is a leading technology solutions provider specializing in delivering innovative networking, cloud, and automation services to enterprises worldwide. With a strong focus on digital transformation, SISL Global empowers organizations to optimize their infrastructure, enhance operational efficiency, and achieve scalable growth. The company prides itself on its commitment to excellence, cutting-edge technology adoption, and fostering a collaborative environment that nurtures talent and innovation. About The Role The NetDevOps Consultant at SISL Global plays a pivotal role in transforming network operations through automation, orchestration, and AI-driven insights. This position requires a highly skilled professional capable of managing complex network environments across cloud, edge, and enterprise settings. The role involves developing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), designing CI/CD pipelines, and integrating observability platforms to ensure proactive monitoring and reliability. The ideal candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Cloud, Security, and SRE, to deliver resilient, scalable, and automated network solutions aligned with modern operational models and AI-first strategies. Qualifications Candidates should possess a strong background in network engineering, with extensive hands-on experience in network automation, scripting, and cloud networking. Relevant certifications such as Cisco CCNP/CCIE, Azure Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Engineer, or similar credentials are preferred. A deep understanding of core networking protocols, network security, and troubleshooting is essential. Experience with automation tools like Python, Ansible, Terraform, and orchestration platforms such as Itential is required. Familiarity with observability tools, ITSM integrations, and multi-cloud environments will be advantageous. The ability to work within a global, 24/7 operational environment, demonstrating excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, is critical. Responsibilities The NetDevOps Consultant will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining network automation workflows using Infrastructure as Code principles. This includes developing and managing NetIaC with tools like Python, Ansible, and Terraform for provisioning and lifecycle management of network infrastructure. They will design and implement CI/CD pipelines utilizing GitOps methodologies, APIs, and orchestration platforms such as Itential to streamline network service deployment. Automation of connectivity services, including VLAN, DNS, Firewall, and DDI, integrated with ServiceNow and ITSM workflows, is a key responsibility. The role also involves driving AI/ML use cases such as WAN capacity forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics to enable self-healing networks and proactive issue resolution. The candidate will integrate observability platforms like SolarWinds Orion, Elastic, Grafana, and ZDX for continuous monitoring and insights, ensuring network stability and security. Supporting AI agent integrations, ensuring AI-driven compliance, security monitoring, and cost optimization are also part of the role. Collaboration with cloud, IAM, SRE, and platform teams across Azure, GCP, and Edge environments to deliver unified control plane operations is vital. The role includes participating in design reviews focusing on resilience, scalability, and automation readiness, as well as creating reusable playbooks, pipelines, and modules for various workflows. Mentoring engineers and promoting best practices in NetDevOps, automation, and reliability engineering are essential functions. The consultant will support global 24x7 operations, aligning efforts with SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets, to reduce incidents through AIOps initiatives. Benefits SISL Global offers a competitive benefits package including comprehensive health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees have access to ongoing professional development opportunities, certifications, and training programs to enhance their skills. The company promotes a collaborative and innovative work environment with flexible working arrangements. Additionally, SISL Global provides opportunities for career advancement, participation in cutting-edge projects, and exposure to a diverse global client base. The organization values work-life balance and fosters a culture of continuous learning and growth. Equal Opportunity SISL Global is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe diversity drives innovation and are dedicated to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

review_candidates.description: Work Location: Anchorage Closing date: 09/13/2026 Schedule: This is a regular exempt Anchorage based position on an urban schedule of a 40-hour week or 9/80-work schedule. Band: K-M Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting day one; FSA; eligible to participate in 401(k) on day one, with 7% company match after one year; pension eligibility starting day one, with 1-year vesting; annual bonus potential; wellness reimbursement; EAP; paid parental leave; educational assistance; vacation and sick leave. Accountabilities and Specific Requirements: The Data Systems Engineer serves as the technical subject matter expert for Operational Technology (OT) data systems supporting pipeline operations and mission-critical systems. This position is responsible for the reliability, security, integration, and lifecycle management of operational data platforms and infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Administer and support the AVEVA PI System, including data archives, interfaces, integrations, and system performance. Administer and maintain Microsoft SQL Server environments and production databases supporting operational systems. Support and maintain Windows and Linux server infrastructure hosting mission-critical systems Support Splunk administration, including data onboarding, alerting, reporting, and dashboard development. Develop and maintain API integrations and automation solutions using Python and PowerShell. Monitor system health, performance, availability, and data integrity across OT environments. Support OT cybersecurity requirements through logging, monitoring, threat detection, and coordination with Cyber Security teams. Lead or support system upgrades, patching, migrations, and technology lifecycle management initiatives. Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures. Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, providing recommendations to improve system reliability, performance, and operational efficiency. Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, Cyber Security, and OT personnel to support critical business and operational objectives. Share technical knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers and support personnel. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: AVEVA PI System administration and integration Microsoft SQL Server administration and database support Splunk administration, monitoring, and dashboard development Python and PowerShell scripting Windows and Linux server administration OT systems architecture and industrial data systems System integration, automation, and performance optimization OT cybersecurity principles and monitoring practices Root cause analysis and troubleshooting Technical documentation and change management Project planning and execution Strong communication and collaboration skills Minimum Qualifications: Applicants must meet or exceed these minimum job requirements to apply for this position. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. Two (2) or more years of experience supporting OT, industrial control systems, data historians, operational databases, or critical infrastructure environments. Experience with one or more of the following technologies: AVEVA PI System, Microsoft SQL Server, Splunk, Windows and Linux server administration, Python or PowerShell scripting. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in pipeline, energy, oil and gas, or critical infrastructure operations. Experience supporting the Trans Alaska Pipeline System (TAPS) or comparable industrial facilities. Experience with OT cybersecurity and industrial data integration technologies.
